answer.summary: Spring ApplicationContext fails to start in the API test shard, so about 347 tests error out. The cause is a circular bean dependency: workflowService -> workflowEndService -> notificationEventService -> scenarioNotificationEventHandler -> exerciseService -> workflowService. The change touches WorkflowEndService, NotificationEventService and the notification handlers, so it likely introduced the cycle. This is deterministic and will repeat on retry. The flake history is not relevant here.

evidence.quote: Relying upon circular references is discouraged and they are prohibited by default.
